provider.name: AntWeb
provider.organization_type: global ant specimen, taxonomy, image, and distribution database
provider.description: AntWeb is a global resource for ant taxonomy, specimen records, collection data, high-resolution specimen images, geographic distributions, maps, institutional holdings, and related biodiversity information.

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting AntWeb documentation, taxonomic and specimen guidance, image policies, API details, data downloads, maps, collection information, legal pages, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: AntWeb and its supporting institutions remain authoritative for specimen records, taxonomy, images, distributions, APIs, downloads, citation, rights, and contact information.

notes: Verify whether /api.do, /api/, or another current path is authoritative.
Do not infer undocumented endpoints from browser traffic alone.
Capture endpoint families, request parameters, response fields, pagination, authentication, rate limits, examples, and legal conditions.
Capture exact official legal wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate specimen facts, taxonomic content, geospatial data, images, and downloadable packages.
Record image-level photographers, institutions, licenses, and credit lines independently.
Do not assume source-code licensing applies to database records or images.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Some legacy .do paths may redirect, be renamed, or be absent; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every specimen, taxon, image, or locality page when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store API keys, passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Specimen facts, taxonomic content, images, collection metadata, maps, downloads, and source code may carry different rights.
